findings.disposition: Fixed: a client request's root insert with a supplied activity_id is rejected ('Operation template cannot choose a stable activity'); keyed on the JWT role claim because the trigger runs as its definer; an approved binding command may set haven.operation_catalog_bind='approved' for its transaction (reserved for COL-135). Two probes added.

findings.claim: a facility change on revision is rejected by the database as invalid lineage scope but the API offered it and mapped the failure to a generic retry
findings.disposition: Fixed: explicit 400 before any command; test added.

findings.claim: the 11 needs_confirmation source items produce draft activities indistinguishable from mapped ones outside the source payload
findings.disposition: Deferred to COL-135 by design: it owns the activity-level applicability state (applicable / not_applicable / needs_confirmation) that makes them distinct and auditable. Recorded in the spec.
